experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1935:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2771:创新类型是新机制。它把 VI-ReID 的问题拆成低高层语义错位和特征分布错位，用欧氏空间和 Hilbert 空间双空间匹配加互蒸馏来讲。能发的点在于它没有只做单一 embedding 对齐，而是把“单空间对齐不够”包装成 gap。story 是：跨模态不应只在一个潜空间里拉近，而要在互补空间中找一致身份线索。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1936:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2777:创新类型是问题重定义和新数据利用。它把车辆图像从“噪声”改写成“有益结构噪声”，用车辆数据模拟真实遮挡并做正则。能发的 gap 是 occluded ReID 数据小，真实车辆遮挡常见但被丢弃。story 很强：噪声不是要清除，而是要可控注入，让模型学会在遮挡下识别人。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1937:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2783:创新类型是问题重定义。它反对“光照不变”和“统一光照”这两条老路，提出每对图像有自己的最优光照距离。能发的 gap 是统一归一化会损失对某些身份有判别力的内容。story 是：不要把所有图像推到同一个标准光照，而要为每对样本选择最有判别力的光照条件。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1938:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2789:创新类型是新机制偏工程组合。它用全局和局部特征互补生成伪标签，再用 GMM 和知识蒸馏去伪标签噪声。能发的 gap 是全局特征聚类有偏，局部信息过去没有真正参与聚类。story 是：伪标签质量来自全局语义和局部细节共同投票，而不是单一全局特征。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1940:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2795:创新类型是问题重定义加新数据设定。它把 ReID 隐私问题从“模糊、加扰”改成“生成新身份替换真实身份”，并提出匿名化数据集和 ISD 指标。能发靠的是伦理合规和可用性之间的明确矛盾。story 是：隐私保护不是隐藏真实 ID，而是从源头替换成可训练但不可追踪的新 ID。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1943:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2831:创新类型是新机制。它把 VI-ReID 的问题拆成低高层语义错位和特征分布错位，用欧氏空间和 Hilbert 空间双空间匹配加互蒸馏来讲。能发的点在于它没有只做单一 embedding 对齐，而是把“单空间对齐不够”包装成 gap。story 是：跨模态不应只在一个潜空间里拉近，而要在互补空间中找一致身份线索。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1944:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2837:创新类型是问题重定义和新数据利用。它把车辆图像从“噪声”改写成“有益结构噪声”，用车辆数据模拟真实遮挡并做正则。能发的 gap 是 occluded ReID 数据小，真实车辆遮挡常见但被丢弃。story 很强：噪声不是要清除，而是要可控注入，让模型学会在遮挡下识别人。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1945:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2843:创新类型是问题重定义。它反对“光照不变”和“统一光照”这两条老路，提出每对图像有自己的最优光照距离。能发的 gap 是统一归一化会损失对某些身份有判别力的内容。story 是：不要把所有图像推到同一个标准光照，而要为每对样本选择最有判别力的光照条件。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1977:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12133:1. 触发观察：CCReID 里视觉外观被衣服强烈污染，传统方法容易困在视觉瓶颈；但直接用 CLIP 也有问题，因为 CLIP 生成或学习的文本往往偏向衣服颜色，而衣服颜色在换衣场景不稳定。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1978:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12135:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12180:1. 触发观察：CCReID 里视觉外观被衣服强烈污染，传统方法容易困在视觉瓶颈；但直接用 CLIP 也有问题，因为 CLIP 生成或学习的文本往往偏向衣服颜色，而衣服颜色在换衣场景不稳定。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:1980:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12182:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2012:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:297:**缺口分析已出**(lifelong_reid_gap-codex.md):候选一(跨阶段同身份桥)零训练先导无效(PRCC 换衣太轻,原型检索已 100%,无空间,决策#51);候选二(多版本陈旧索引)其次,且能用手上 Market/MSMT/Occ-Duke 标准不相交身份序列直接做。候选三(阶段顺序敏感桥选择)备选,最接近 AKT/DASA/DKAR 先例压力大。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2013:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:366:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2014:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:367:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2015:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:376:- 为什么排第一：换衣是强主干仍明确失败的具体干扰（PRCC 换衣远低于同衣）；我们有独有观察（PRCC 换衣对 w 有约 7 分响应、Occ-Duke/LTCC 不响应）；已发表换衣方法都靠衣服标签/解析/CLIP/生成，"用预训练自带语义旋钮控衣服捷径、无衣服标签、测试单 embedding"是干净区分点。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2017:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:481:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2043:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:253:**缺口分析已出**(lifelong_reid_gap-codex.md):候选一(跨阶段同身份桥)零训练先导无效(PRCC 换衣太轻,原型检索已 100%,无空间,决策#51);候选二(多版本陈旧索引)其次,且能用手上 Market/MSMT/Occ-Duke 标准不相交身份序列直接做。候选三(阶段顺序敏感桥选择)备选,最接近 AKT/DASA/DKAR 先例压力大。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2044:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:322:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2045:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:323:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3434:创新类型是工程组合偏新机制。能发是因为它抓住了手工分块错位、姿态估计噪声大且忽略背包等非人体细节这两个 gap，用自适应部位提取和遮挡权重讲通。story 是“不依赖重姿态分支，也能找到可见局部并抑制遮挡局部”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2060:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3443:创新类型是新机制和生成增广。gap 是可见光红外数据少、模态差异大，GAN 非可逆且红外到可见光困难。它用双 flow 共享高斯空间，同时做扩样和跨模态翻译。story 是“可逆潜空间把跨模态生成和训练样本生成统一起来”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2061:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3446:创新类型是问题重定义加新机制。它把泛化 ReID 的困难点定义成“身份相关和无关特征在困难匹配样本中纠缠”，再用度量关系反转但外观尽量保持的生成器制造困难样本。story 是“先主动制造最难的度量样本，再训练模型防御和净化身份语义”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2062:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3449:创新类型是生成增广机制。gap 是标注数据少，渲染和 GAN 的真实感、身份一致性不足。它用 ReID 身份嵌入和姿态热图条件扩散，生成同身份不同姿态样本。story 是“身份保持的任意姿态扩散增广，低数据时更有价值”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2063:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3452:创新类型是新机制，但赛道拥挤。gap 是 CLIP 这类视觉语言模型偏全局语义，遮挡下忽略细粒度属性，而人工属性标注成本高。story 是“不加人工属性，从 CLIP 内部挖细粒度属性伪标签，补全全局提示的盲点”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2064:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3474:区别：最像 APD，但 APD 在潜空间里做度量扰动，物理含义弱。我们把困难样本定义成 SMPL 相机、可见面、投影尺度改变后产生的“同人不像、异人很像”的物理困难样本。也不同于扩散增广论文，因为第一版可以只做 mask/token 级视角扰动，不碰高成本图像生成。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:625:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2076:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:626:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2077:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:635:- 为什么排第一：换衣是强主干仍明确失败的具体干扰（PRCC 换衣远低于同衣）；我们有独有观察（PRCC 换衣对 w 有约 7 分响应、Occ-Duke/LTCC 不响应）；已发表换衣方法都靠衣服标签/解析/CLIP/生成，"用预训练自带语义旋钮控衣服捷径、无衣服标签、测试单 embedding"是干净区分点。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2090:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:8941:2. 重定义动作：他们把“memory bank 怎么更新”从实现细节抬成了核心问题。旧说法是无监督 ReID 难在伪标签噪声和聚类质量；他们的新说法是，伪标签生成后，历史特征如何被保存、采样、淘汰，会直接决定对比学习看到的负样本分布。关键词是 multi-queue、historical features、resampling、trainable temperature、hard samples。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2091:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:8955:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制和重定义绑定较紧。先用 human parsing 抠出衣服区域，让多个 LVLM 只描述衣服，并用粗粒度和细粒度提示生成多种衣服 caption。再用 CLIP 相似度过滤，保留最可信的两个描述。SGE 分支让图像特征和衣服文本做注意力，然后从视觉特征里减去衣服相关成分。PIE 分支直接遮掉衣服区域训练，让模型被迫使用更稳定的身体、姿态、局部线索。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2092:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:8979:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制很顺。先用 SCHP 生成衣服擦除图，再用 AAPAR 识别 35 类属性。年龄、性别被当作身份相关属性，头饰、上衣、下装、鞋、配饰等被当作衣服相关属性。然后用模板把属性变成文本，在 raw image branch 和 masked image branch 上用 CLIP ViT 加 visual deep prompt 学图像表示。属性解耦部分把图像特征和身份相关文本拼接，用 triplet 促进保留；对衣服相关文本用负向损失或对抗约束进行压制。BNNeck 用来隔开图像调优和文本对齐，避免一个目标破坏另一个目标。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2093:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:9018:2. 重定义动作：他们把“memory bank 怎么更新”从实现细节抬成了核心问题。旧说法是无监督 ReID 难在伪标签噪声和聚类质量；他们的新说法是，伪标签生成后，历史特征如何被保存、采样、淘汰，会直接决定对比学习看到的负样本分布。关键词是 multi-queue、historical features、resampling、trainable temperature、hard samples。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2160:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4463:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:883:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2161:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4474:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1140:4. **证据闭环**：最关键证据是人为构造不同失衡比例。SYSU-MM01 从 2:1 到 4:1、8:1，很多已有方法 rank-1 和 mAP 大幅下滑，而 CMBL 下滑明显小。组件消融也很有说服力：2:1 下 baseline 是 63.79 rank-1、59.87 mAP，完整 CMBL 到 76.36、71.64；8:1 下 baseline 是 40.20、34.39，完整 CMBL 到 70.62、65.72。SSP 插入层位置、MMD 三项、CACS 的 intra/inter 都分别消融。可视化上还对比 SMOTE 和 SSP 的生成分布，并展示分类 logit 更稳定。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4478:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1172:2. **重定义动作**：他们把数据增强从“生成逼真的人图”重定义为“基于行人结构语义单元做组合扩展”。关键词是 semantic reorganization、semantic restructuring-based data augmentation、structural combinatorial enhancement、training enhancement + testing calibration、cross-modal similarity re-ranking。旧问题从“缺真实图片”变成“缺足够多上身、下身、语义组合变化”；从“排序不准”变成“文本 query 需要可靠跨模态邻域来校准”。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2191:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:6923:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果缺的是同一身份多服装数据，那机制自然就是用 3D 人体、服装资产、纹理替换和虚拟相机生成可控数据。裸人体网格定义身份，服装和纹理定义换衣变化，Unreal Engine 模拟监控场景，检测器自动裁框和生成标签。后面的预训练加微调只是让这个大规模合成分布进入普通模型。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2193:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:6987:3. 机制怎么长出来：第一阶段用 CLIP 和可学习 prompt 给每个相机内身份生成隐式文本描述。第二阶段用相机内混合记忆库存身份中心特征和实例特征，同时拉近同身份中心和困难正样本，推开困难负样本。第三阶段做跨相机关联和原型对比，再用 ICAL 惩罚模型区分同一伪身份在不同相机下的全局 ID。机制和重定义绑定很紧，因为每一步都在回答“相机内标签能提供什么，跨相机噪声怎么压”。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2211:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:337:- 为什么排第一：换衣是强主干仍明确失败的具体干扰（PRCC 换衣远低于同衣）；我们有独有观察（PRCC 换衣对 w 有约 7 分响应、Occ-Duke/LTCC 不响应）；已发表换衣方法都靠衣服标签/解析/CLIP/生成，"用预训练自带语义旋钮控衣服捷径、无衣服标签、测试单 embedding"是干净区分点。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2213:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:442:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2258:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2283:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2284:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:936:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:76:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2285:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:64:如果训练版 `LM-ReID + K marginalization` 能在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble 再高 **+0.8 到 +2.0 mAP**，并且 h=24 仍有稳定收益，信心到 **8/10**。如果只停留在零训练 ensemble，最多 **5/10**。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2287:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1023:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4632:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8892:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2295:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2296:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2317:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1236:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2322:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2332:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2333:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1265:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2334:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2363:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1608:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2364:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2365:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2405:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2509:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15641:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2437:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3099:关联：`experiments/paradigm_shift/`（README + 3 路 gap + 决策）、memory [[post-prcv-directions-exhausted]] [[exp109-headroom-is-a-wall]] [[fm-import-occluded-reid-closed]]。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2439:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2440:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3354:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "PSC-JEPA|support-set|continued pretrain|pseudo-support|JEPA|exp35[0-9]|exp360|Intruder|OGFR|DPEFormer|KPR|QPM|target ambiguity|frozen kill-switch|kill-switch" experiments/paradigm_shift experiments/cargo_cvpb experiments/exp35* experiments/exp360_intruder -S' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2441:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3401:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2442:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3421:experiments/exp356_pcmsc/design.md:57:**为何**: kill-switch 早警示 CLIP 每部位特征只带弱 ID(gap+0.01, 各向异性挤窄锥)。逼 backbone 重建这个**弱且各向异性**的 CLIP 部位语义 → 把 backbone 拉向弱判别的 CLIP 特征、偏离 ID-判别方向 → 伤。补全目标弱 → 补全正则有害。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2443:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3522:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3656:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:3:> 战略重思后选定(5 死角后, 3 codex strat 强收敛)。★★方法论转向: **放弃"验证 confound 是真依赖"(杀光一切), 改 empirical 涨点导向**——在 CARGO baseline 上试 +module 能否 beat = 真 kill-switch。这是 167 篇库真实配方(命名 gap + 2 模块 + 多数据集 SOTA 表 + framing)。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2445:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3599:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review.md:1:# Codex Review — exp359 LM-ReID
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2447:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3679:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3986:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2450:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3682:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3993:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1285:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2928:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2451:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3683:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3994:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2929:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2468:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3700:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4011:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5307:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=从相邻领域搬训练范式: 'LR bbox/采样格点是要边缘化的隐变量'这设定, 哪个相邻领域训练机制能映射且避开invariance-collapse? 候选评估: amortized-variational-inference(把marginalization学进网络)/detection-jitter-robust-training/test-time-training训练侧/super-resolution-as-auxiliary/deep-equilibrium/EM-style-latent。求: 最值1-2个 + 具体机制 + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2494:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3738:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4331:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:2484:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20056:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2496:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3740:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4333:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:2511:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21190:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1617:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2513:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3758:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4351:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:2539:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21636:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2514:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3759:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4352:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:2540:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21638:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5338:reassess/r_3.md:4020:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2744:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2515:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3761:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4385:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3188:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1617:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2532:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3831:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4455:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3269:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1761:reassess/r_3.md:3890:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3373:和本批最像工作的区别：最像 `FMCNet+`。它补偿可见光和红外的模态特异特征，我们补偿航拍和地面视角下缺失的身体表面和局部身份残差。关键切开点是用 SMPL 可见性和姿态热图约束生成什么，不做无约束特征幻觉。  
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2533:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3832:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4456:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3270:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2930:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1771:reassess/r_3.md:3902:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3447:和本批最像工作的区别：最像 `FMCNet+`。它补偿可见光和红外的模态特异特征，我们补偿航拍和地面视角下缺失的身体表面和局部身份残差。关键切开点是用 SMPL 可见性和姿态热图约束生成什么，不做无约束特征幻觉。  
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2534:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3833:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4457:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3271:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2535:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3834:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4458:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3272:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2977:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1818:reassess/r_3.md:4014:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2694:一句话 headline：用 SMPL 生成训练期身份几何 token，把 LVLM 式“语义 token”改成不依赖语言、不增加测试成本的 3D 人体 token。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2536:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3835:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4459:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3273:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2540:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3844:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4468:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3282:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3149:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4202:reassess/r_2.md:1158:reassess/r_3.md:2382:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/novelty_gopl.txt:12:| (e) SMPL / 3D-geometry-guided ReID | 存活但不能大喊 first | [OG-Net / 3D Space ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569) 已把 2D 图像映射到 3D point cloud / visible surface 上学习 ReID 表征；[GCL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.09071) 用 HMR mesh rotation 生成新视角并做 contrastive；[CASE-Net / SMPL-reID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.07340) 用 SMPL 合成数据研究换衣/shape。 | 已有人用 SMPL/mesh/3D 做 ReID 表征、生成、合成数据。GOPL 的切口是：**SMPL 只作 pair-reliability meter，不作 identity feature、不作 alignment、不作 augmentation**。这个切口目前没看到确切先例。 | 8/10 |
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2541:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3845:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4469:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3283:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3278:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4331:reassess/r_2.md:1640:reassess/r_3.md:3614:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3474:区别：最像 APD，但 APD 在潜空间里做度量扰动，物理含义弱。我们把困难样本定义成 SMPL 相机、可见面、投影尺度改变后产生的“同人不像、异人很像”的物理困难样本。也不同于扩散增广论文，因为第一版可以只做 mask/token 级视角扰动，不碰高成本图像生成。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2547:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3851:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4475:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3289:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2561:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3865:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4489:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3303:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2563:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3871:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4495:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2584:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3954:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。
experiments/exp362_genoccl/codex_gap_decision.md:2585:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3959:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:702:experiments/exp330_compositional_dro/design.md:63:- kill-switch 设计成功：训练判据(非frozen)便宜判死。ERM 续 e40 确认 gap 稳定。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7790:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2928:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16139:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7823:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7827:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3495:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_dualbranch.md:43:审查通过。双分支 = 2 BNNeck head(f_full 保 G→A / f_rec consistency 服务低清 A→G,共享 1 forward)+ 融合 eval(=#3 GATE-5)+ off 字节级 + 两 head 真分化 + 都进 optimizer + NaN-safe + train/test 对称。smoke 11/11 + 回归 21/21。codex 审 + GPU 即训 kill-switch #4:**dualbranch fuse mean ≥ baseline 60.84 +1.0(=61.84)→ 机制成立(B 类候选);否则杀。**

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7846:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3652:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3503:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2158:./ondisk_pivot.md:4421:./reassess/r_3.md:4741:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:293:**判断**：FM-import / generic-paradigm-import 方向保持关闭（各有机制，已入 memory+study）。真正没撞墙的下一前沿 = **问题 reframe**（reliability/uncertainty-aware matching 或 common-visible support / pair comparability，CLAUDE.md 钦定）——level-1 重定义创新，多日研究线，非一夜 kill-switch。**拒绝在 3am 编造注定撞同墙的 FM-import 实验充数**（CLAUDE.md：不做组合实验逃避创新）。当前真决策点 = λ=1 e10 oracle（Jaccard vs 0.253）。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7877:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3954:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

(b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3993:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7880:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3997:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:951:experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7881:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4010:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1042:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4833:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14585:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7902:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4158:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1547:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2333:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1755:../../cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7908:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4201:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1603:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3612:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5532:reassess/r_3.md:5083:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:1487:     3	> **来源**：exp324 frozen 首验通过 kill-switch（姿态部位匹配在重遮挡上 ×3.4 mAP 超整图，且均匀网格不涨→涨点全来自姿态锚定）。本实验验证"训一个轻量头能否把冻结 DINO 部位特征拉到可用/可打 KPR"。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7909:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4206:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1608:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7910:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4207:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7911:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4208:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1610:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3632:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5624:reassess/r_3.md:6129:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7912:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4211:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1613:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3637:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5651:reassess/r_3.md:6512:./pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7925:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4233:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7935:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9801:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_7.md:7116:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果 clean 是可靠 exemplar，corrupted 是异质模态，那么 teacher-student 蒸馏很自然：冻结 clean teacher，用 corrupted student 向 clean feature 对齐。严重 corruption 是 hard sample，所以加 weighted contrastive loss。又因为严格对齐会丢信息，所以用 Brownian bridge 生成 clean 与 corrupted 之间的中间特征，填出连续语义结构。机制和重定义绑定很强。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7943:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3598:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2502:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5111:./reassess/r_3.md:11643:reviews/deep_23.md:489:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7946:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10154:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7949:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10219:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2050:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1187:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7950:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10423:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5706:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2269:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1406:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2502:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5111:./reassess/r_3.md:11643:reviews/deep_23.md:489:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7984:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11555:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7985:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11557:我会先把项目里最新结论读一遍，确认 exp109/exp148 的上下文没有被误读；同时查 2024-2026 相关论文，重点看“训练期多帧/特权信息蒸馏到单图”和“遮挡者身份泄漏抑制”有没有直接先例。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7989:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12225:**realizable 同 camera tracklet union 只拿到 16.3% 的 oracle 恢复 (远低于 40% 门槛), 且只比免费 k-reciprocal 强 ~2.3x。FGEU 撞 exp109 query-side 墙 — 大 headroom 只存在于部署不可得的 cross-camera 同 ID 证据里, realizable 的同机位多帧拿不到。判 DEAD 3/10。**

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8014:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12292:ratio 从 bottom-50% 的 16.3% → bottom-30% 的 **16.5%**, 纹丝不动。注意越难的 query realizable 绝对增益越大 (+12.72, 比 k-recip 强 6.5x), 但 oracle 同步放大 (+32.09), **headroom-realizable 的差是结构性的, 不是阈值噪声**。比例 pin 在 ~16% = realizable 永远只能恢复约 1/6 的 cross-camera 证据 headroom。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8020:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12387:experiments/decisions.md:4511:**执行结果**：SD/DIFT 线止损，不上头。**重要方法论教训写入铁律：训练-free probe 必须用全量 gallery 判定绝对值，小 gallery smoke 只验流程不验数值**——DIFT 是活教材（smoke 排第一、full 垫底）。结合 exp327（registers +0.29 小幅、不破天花板）：**换特征源（更新 DINO / 换 SD 范式）都不是 frozen 天花板的解**，瓶颈在 frozen 本身（需 LoRA/解冻，即 exp324d 线）或换"DINO 补 Swin"重量级角度（planner #1 oracle）。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8197:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/false_negative_audit.txt:13:| ⑤ RMA-TIReID | **最可疑，但不是“看起来活”。** 现有 kill 是 token-prototype≈color-only、非颜色 token 约 1 mAP、跨域 R1 49。这个更像“当前 probe 没测到非颜色语义”，不如前几项硬。Text-image ReID 外部主线已经很卷，IRRA/RDE 等都在做 cross-modal/local alignment/noisy correspondence。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12501?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.09911?utm_source=openai)) 所以它最多值得一次廉价复核，不值得直接复活。 | 6/10 |
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8208:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14054:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1751:../../cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:145:- f_rec 的 consistency **只读 logits_rec/bn_feat_rec**, 梯度回流 **shared backbone + bottleneck_rec**, **f_full 的 BNNeck/classifier 完全不受 consistency 影响**(smoke D4: f_full grad=0)→ 两 head 不是同一空间复制, f_full 留判别性、f_rec 攻低清。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8213:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14078:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:2071:experiments/decisions.md:4511:**执行结果**：SD/DIFT 线止损，不上头。**重要方法论教训写入铁律：训练-free probe 必须用全量 gallery 判定绝对值，小 gallery smoke 只验流程不验数值**——DIFT 是活教材（smoke 排第一、full 垫底）。结合 exp327（registers +0.29 小幅、不破天花板）：**换特征源（更新 DINO / 换 SD 范式）都不是 frozen 天花板的解**，瓶颈在 frozen 本身（需 LoRA/解冻，即 exp324d 线）或换"DINO 补 Swin"重量级角度（planner #1 oracle）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8214:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8215:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14141:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8249:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14341:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8250:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14342:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3955:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8251:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14356:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6395:一个 ReID 团队的 **evidence-sufficiency** 方向零训练 kill-switch LIVE+强: ①诊断真——weak positive-support(query 对自己跨相机正样本的最弱相似度 lowtail-pos / 正样本散度 dispersion)驱动失败, partial 控 1x-margin+#false 后仍 +0.44~0.52(两域), 决定性区别于被 trivial 吃掉的旧诊断(Hubness 控 #false 后塌到 0); ②oracle 证据 union——给失败 query 加第 2 张同 ID 图, Occluded-Duke 从 17.2→52.5(+35, 恢复 76.8%), 加随机异 ID 图反而砸毁(证明增益是身份证据非降噪), 且是 k-reciprocal 增益的 3.3x(现成 re-rank 盖不住)。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8291:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14893:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20398:| ⑤ RMA-TIReID | **最可疑，但不是“看起来活”。** 现有 kill 是 token-prototype≈color-only、非颜色 token 约 1 mAP、跨域 R1 49。这个更像“当前 probe 没测到非颜色语义”，不如前几项硬。Text-image ReID 外部主线已经很卷，IRRA/RDE 等都在做 cross-modal/local alignment/noisy correspondence。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12501?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.09911?utm_source=openai)) 所以它最多值得一次廉价复核，不值得直接复活。 | 6/10 |

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8332:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15077:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4046:./reassess/r_3.md:1954:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8352:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15143:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8353:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15146:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2720:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:953:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8391:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15246:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:5748:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:953:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8481:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15641:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8509:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15742:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11555:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8514:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15908:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5133:reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8515:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15909:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8522:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15924:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5843:reassess/r_3.md:8051:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8542:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:8565:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16070:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4599:./reassess/r_3.md:7730:./reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
